sentences.text: Corey Todd Taylor -LRB- born December 8 , 1973 -RRB- is an American musician , singer , songwriter , actor and author , best known as the lead singer and lyricist of the American nu metal band Slipknot and the American hard rock and alternative metal band Stone Sour .	nu metal	nu metal	alternative metal	alternative metal	hard rock	hard rock	Slipknot	Slipknot (band)	Stone Sour	Stone Sour
Taylor joined Slipknot in 1997 to replace their original vocalist , Anders Colsefni .	Slipknot	Slipknot (band)
He has released five studio albums with them .

He has worked with several bands , including Junk Beer Kidnap Band , Korn , Disturbed , Apocalyptica , Anthrax , Aaron Lewis of Staind , and Soulfly .	Korn	Korn	Disturbed	Disturbed (band)	Apocalyptica	Apocalyptica	Junk Beer Kidnap Band	Junk Beer Kidnap Band	Anthrax	Anthrax (American band)	Aaron Lewis	Aaron Lewis	Staind	Staind	Soulfly	Soulfly
Taylor was ranked at number 86 in Hit Parader 's Top 100 Metal Vocalists of All Time .	Hit Parader	Hit Parader
He was also named the seventh greatest heavy metal frontman by NME .	NME	NME
Taylor was also found , by VVN Music , to possess the second-widest vocal range of any known singer in popular music with a range of 5 and a half octaves .
He was beaten only by Mike Patton -LRB- 6 octaves -RRB- .	Mike Patton	Mike Patton
